svg.text: Quartets for all 9 lift grids — {S, S+9a, S+9b, S+9c}
digit colour = +3-orbit. amber-ringed cell = the close, where one digit is the sum of the other two and the quartet hits a repdigit.
6 of 27 rows close. Column sums are always 12, 15, 18 — each column is a whole +3-orbit — so no lift grid can be magic.
Grids 7 and 8 are the only two with all row sums equal to 15, the magic constant. Rows balance; columns cannot.
